content.bridge_context: Understanding that every kind of work has value and dignity, whether it is done in an office or on the street.

units.title: Dignity of Labour
units.explanation: No work is superior or inferior; every person contributing to society deserves respect.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think of the person who cleans your street. Why is their work important? / जो व्यक्ति आपकी गली साफ करता है, उसका काम क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?

units.title: Division of Labour
units.explanation: People do different jobs based on their skills and the needs of society.
units.dual_language_instruction: What would happen if everyone in the city wanted to be a doctor? / यदि शहर का हर व्यक्ति डॉक्टर बनना चाहता तो क्या होता?
